title: Entity: Draft
description: Prepared pre-publication marketplace entity used to create published listings.
text:
# Draft

TL;DR:
- Draft is the prepared version of a listing before publication.
- A published listing is created from a draft.
- Listing creation is part of the draft workflow, not an ad hoc direct creation path.

What it is:
- A draft is the seller-side preparation model for a future listing.

What it is used for:
- It is used to edit, validate, and prepare marketplace content before publication.

Relationships:
- draft -> listing (publication)
- draft -> gallery
- draft -> category
- draft -> location

Role note:
- Draft belongs to seller workflow, not buyer browsing workflow.

Agent hint:
- If the task is about preparing or editing content before it becomes public, think draft first, not listing.
